growing_family.cap_and_concentration: Outward entropy precision grows with n; mean self-information <=2*k-m eventually. Variance <=(13/4)*n*g*g and m=4*g*ceil(sqrt(n*bit_length(n))) make the length-event probability vanish. Only the charged grid parent and one-bit child survive.
growing_family.entropy_proof: Forced signs are recoverable from completion and erasure mask, giving H(Y)>=5*g/8. A random priority has expected log first-compatible rank <=5*g/8; an explicit prefix code adds at most 2*log2(g+1)+1. Published greedy guarantee adds log2(e), hence H_G/g tends to 5/8.
growing_family.polynomial_design: 16**g<=2*n for the public schedule (including small g=1 only once n>=8); design uses O(4**g) incidences and O(g)-bit weights. Encoder/updater use polynomially many operations on O(k)-bit integers; data/program/runtime costs are separate.
growing_family.published_input: Cardinal/Fiorini/Joret Theorem 1 and its rational weighted extension; generic minimum-entropy greedy cover is established.
growing_family.scope: Analytic family limit with implemented variable-g primitives and declared finite diagnostics; no all-n source enumeration, efficient near-C67 guarantee, generic novelty or portable runtime.

information_contract.temporary_workspace: Allowed within each stage and discarded; actors are trusted pure functions, not isolated untrusted processes.

limits: Specific uniform source/query law. Published weighted greedy-cover approximation and generic quantization/time sharing/arithmetic intervals are established. Pair entropy optimum is restricted; eight-group greedy code is not optimal. Large finite risk bounds use root-enclosed Chernoff moments, not exact risk/failure averages or complete physical source grading. Selected smaller designs lose; forty margin designs are inspected, not an exhaustive allocation search or independent trials. Growing-family proof has declared code complexity and finite diagnostic scope, not a near-C67 or portable-runtime guarantee. External correctness/priority and natural-agent/model/token/credit/production benefit remain open; original results and provider allocations unchanged.
pair_optimum_scope: Among compatible source-wise nearest constant-pair choices: mandatory masses >=25 each and maximum <=121 imply domination by [121,85,25,25]/256. Greedy attains that vector. Not a global quantizer or rate-distortion optimum.
public_storage_scope: Eight-block cover priority/counts 1280 bytes plus eight oracle response/count bytes. Public n/g/a, program/runtime/framing and growing-family tables are separate; value bits do not imply token/cost or RAM savings.

weighted_cover_checks.scope: All weighted source categories, not physical enumeration of all 16**g sources.
